'''Nullify toxin in another''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to expel harmful toxins and [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] from an individual's body.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[block pain]], [[heal]], [[lessen another's pain]], [[nullify toxin]], and [[speed healing]] spells.
